id: title:dmarchuk:keep the workflow page from scrolling when the step panel is open

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the layout behavior of the WorkflowScene's tab container and its child tab items, potentially preserving tab content or scrollbars and affecting the visual stability of the workflow editor UI.
review.reason: Replaced Tailwind utility classes in the WorkflowScene tab container, adding 'min-h-0' to prevent collapsing and removing 'flex-1' from the parent. This is a localized, bounded UI behavior correction.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether the previous layout caused unwanted collapsing or scrolling, which is not demonstrated by the code alone; this could also be a minor visual adjustment rather than a critical fix.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only one hunk. No score assigned. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaced a Tailwind utility class string, adding 'min-h-0' to the parent container and its direct children, while removing the parent's previous 'flex-1' and adding it to the children.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the layout behavior of the WorkflowScene's tab container and its child tab items. Adding 'min-h-0' prevents the parent and children from collapsing to zero height, potentially preserving tab content or scrollbars. This could affect the visual stability of the workflow editor UI.
